survivedNarration: ^The message has been delivered, and the Shogunate has been routed. As they sought refuge and prepared for a defense in Yodo Castle, the Shogun's forces found its heavy gates closed to them, and Tsu castle soon after.

^Lacking any way to dig in, the Tokugawa army retreated to Osaka castle, where their Shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, abandoned his army and escaped by sea back to Edo. The castle fell without resistance after mass defections and a collapse of morale, and the Imperial forces won both the central Kansai region of Japan and an even larger symbolic victory.
^I believe that with the help of my message, we are one step closer to the Imperial restoration, but my journey does not end here.
^I must travel to Edo as a messenger to inform our Imperial forces of the Shogunates desperate plan... to burn Edo to the ground.
